questions.question: When Jesus walked beside two of His followers on the road to Emmaus, what was strange about it?

answers.text: They were kept from recognizing Him
He walked without saying a single word
He stayed a few steps behind them

questions.question: On the road to Emmaus, where did Jesus begin when He explained the Scriptures about Himself?

answers.text: With Moses and all the Prophets
With the words of John the Baptist

questions.question: At a table in Emmaus, Jesus broke bread and gave it to two followers. What happened to them then?

answers.text: Their eyes were opened and they knew Him
They asked Him where He was really from
They thanked Him and said goodnight

questions.question: Looking back, what did the two followers say their hearts were doing while Jesus explained the Scriptures on the road?
